full_page.content:
Page 114
Dec. 1st Sally Wittenberg - 5 last June - of Wayne - never walked; seeming- ly normal otherwise. Her father fallen from practice of religion.
Mich Mullett - 13 - nerve trouble trouble - sometime sight fits .. Enrolled 5.
Bonnie Welling - 2 - hurt mentaly at birth - very fidgity Carol Ann Byozinski - 5 - spells like Epyl ...
Gertrude Ward - 29 - convulsions in sleep - sometimes in sleep. Mrs. Magdalen - 40 - broken ankel May 26 three breaks - finds it difficult to take care of her family.
Frank Ogurek - 27 - wounded in action July 19th over in Sicely - now in a hospital near Columbus, 0. Mother hopes to get him home.
Baby David Mitchell 22 Episcopelien -mental since birth ... Br. Isle
Page 115 Dec. 9th Maureen Naiditch - 15 - infantile since July 20 - St. Benedict's Parish ..... in iron - lung for two months ..... now out of it and able to breathe ... but back still very stiff .. .Now in Mt. Clemens.
Rev. E. Ullman - 32 - has apparently lost his vocation or simply nerveous break. .
10 John Jansen - 59 - rushed to Prov. Hosp. with two blood vessels broken. Drs have very little hope of recovery. Daughter phones en- rollment at 2:50 P.M. Phones again late and early a.m. still hem- oragging .... comes (daughter) and enrolls him at about 10:45 a.m.
Wm. Fenwick - 28 - non-cath. but wife Catholic - inward hemorage - ear abcess, unconscious now 36 hours. Enrolled To-night in S.M.A.
Michael Generals - 58 - lost memory after operation last May ... Seemed to have something like stroke .... Asked about Holy Communion ... once a year living next door to Church (St. Eliz. ) .... Enrolled ... promising monthly Com.
Henry Camden - 7 - has been extremely nerveous since cutting.
Page 116 H.C. cont. Dec. his teeth at 8 months; was bright and normal at a year old, failing ever since more and more; of late takes as many as 5 and six times a day. Enrolled Today 5.
